derivation: from H2114 (זוּר) in the sense of turning aside from truth;

occurrences.text: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
